answer: Random mutual audit makes each agent a mirror for another: each epoch work is mirrored to a random peer who re-runs a sample against its fingerprint. A sparrow-light honest agent pays 5 POA an epoch. A farm that forges 1,000 identities pays 1,000 x 5 POA fees + 1,000 x 20 POA deposits, yet each fake is caught in 3 epochs, earning at most 400 POA. Fakes forfeit deposits, auditors take a 10% bounty, honest agents pay once, sybils a thousand times.
